instruction: Follow the app's flow (using the static analysis guidance) from launch until it triggers the Accessibility Service prompt and navigates to System Accessibility Settings. Do NOT toggle a malicious service ON.

steps.model_output:

elements.content_desc: Accessibility service. Lets the tap zone sit directly on the status bar. It does not read or send any screen text.. Turn on
Display over other apps. Draws the tap zone below the status bar when the Accessibility service is not active.. Turn on

elements.text: If the accessibility switch is greyed out:
Open App info, tap the three-dot menu at the top right, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
